Dearest NAME_HERE,

Happy, happy birthday! 🎉

On this special day, I just want to remind you of how truly incredible, kind, and inspiring you are. You make every day brighter with your kindness, humor, and beautiful smile.

May this new year of your life bring you unlimited happiness, unforgettable adventures, blooming success, and all the love you so richly deserve.
